question: CAT = 24 hai (C=3, A=1, T=20 ka yog). DOG ka man kya hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — A=1…Z=26 se: D=4, O=15, G=7; yog = 4 + 15 + 7 = 26. CAT = 3+1+20 = 24 iska udaharan tha. | Galat kyun: A (30) aur B (28) galat yog hain; C (24) CAT ka maan hai, DOG ka nahi. | Concept: Coding me pehle aksharon ke sthan (A=1…Z=26) likho, phir yog karo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: A=1, Z=26 — akshar ko number me badlo. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Yadi CAT = DBU hai (pratyek akshar +1), to DOG kya hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Har akshar +1: D→E, O→P, G→H; DOG = EPH. | Galat kyun: A (EOH) O ko +1 nahi karta; B (DPH) D ko +1 nahi karta; D (FQI) +2 ka pattern hai. | Concept: Letter shifting — har akshar par wahi niyam lagta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ek akshar check karo, phir sab par lagao. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Shrinkhala: A, C, F, J, O, ... agla akshar kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Aksharon ke sthan: A(1), C(3), F(6), J(10), O(15); antar: +2, +3, +4, +5; agla +6 → O + 6 = 21 = U. | Galat kyun: B (S) aur D (T) antar ko +4/+5 par rokne se bante hain; C (R) galat ginati hai. | Concept: Letter series me antar ko number me badal kar dekho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Antar likho — 2, 3, 4, 5, 6… | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Shrinkhala: 3, 9, 27, 81, ... agla pad kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Har pad ×3 hai: 3, 9, 27, 81; agla = 81 × 3 = 243. | Galat kyun: A (216) 6³ hai — pattern se nahi banta; C (108) 81 + 27 hai — yog ka pattern nahi; D (162) 81 × 2 hai. | Concept: Pehle antar dekho, phir guna-bhag ka pattern. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 3, 9, 27, 81 — teeno guna. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Shrinkhala: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ... agla pad kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Ye varg sankhyaein hain: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5²; agla 6² = 36. | Galat kyun: A (30) aur C (32) varg nahi hain; D (49) 7² hai — 6² chhoot gaya. | Concept: Varg shrinkhala: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49… | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Varg yaad rakho — 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B2.

question: Ram ne ek ladki ki taraf ishara karke kaha — 'woh meri maa ki ikloti beti ki beti hai.' Ladki Ram ki kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Maa ki ikloti beti = Ram ki behen; uski beti = Ram ki bhanji. | Galat kyun: A (bhatiji) bhai ki beti hoti hai; B (beti) Ram ki apni beti hoti — sawal me behen ki beti hai; C (behen) woh ladki nahi, uski maa hai. | Concept: Blood relation me pehle 'kis ki' ko pehchano, phir rishta jodo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 'Maa ki ikloti beti' = behen; behen ki beti = bhanji. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B3.

question: 40 students me Ram upar se 12th hai. Neeche se uska sthan kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Neeche se sthan = Kul − Upar se sthan + 1 = 40 − 12 + 1 = 29th. | Galat kyun: A (30th) +1 bhoolne se banta hai; B (27th) aur D (28th) galat ghata hain. | Concept: Ranking me +1 isliye jodte hain kyunki vyakti khud bhi gina jata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kul − upar + 1 — '+1 mat bhoolo'. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: 3 baje ghadi ki suiyon ke beech kitne degree ka kon banta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 3 baje ghante ki sui 3 par aur minute ki sui 12 par hoti hai — beech ka kon 90° (samkon) hota hai. | Galat kyun: A (120°) 4 baje ka kon hota hai; C (60°) 2 baje ka; D (180°) 6 baje ka. | Concept: Har ghanta = 30° (360° ÷ 12); 3 ghante = 90°. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Ghante × 30° — 3 × 30 = 90. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: Kitab : Padhna :: Kalam : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kitab padhne ke liye hoti hai, waise hi kalam likhne ke liye hota hai — vastu : uska upyog. | Galat kyun: A (kagaz) likhne ki jagah hai, kalam ka upyog nahi; B (syahi) kalam ke andar hoti hai; C (padhai) kitab se judi hai, kalam se nahi. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'vastu : kriya'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kitab→Padhna, Kalam→Likhna — kaam ka joda. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Doctor hospital me kaam karta hai, waise hi teacher school me kaam karta hai — vyakti : karyasthal. | Galat kyun: A (class) school ka hissa hai, karyasthal nahi; B (student) teacher ka 'grahak' hai; C (book) teacher ka auzaar hai. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'vyakti : uska karyasthal'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Doctor→Hospital, Teacher→School. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Visham (odd one out) chuniye: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 9 composite (abhajya nahi) hai: 9 = 3 × 3; baki 2, 3, 5, 7 sab prime hain. | Galat kyun: A (2) ekmatra sam prime hai — prime hi hai; B (7) aur C (3) bhi prime hain. | Concept: Prime = sirf 1 aur khud se vibhajya; composite = aur bhi gunankhand. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 9 = 3×3 — prime nahi. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Visham chuniye: Rose, Lotus, Marigold, Mango
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mango phal hai; Rose, Lotus, Marigold teeno phool hain. | Galat kyun: B (Rose), C (Marigold), D (Lotus) sab phool hain — isiliye odd nahi. | Concept: Odd one out me pehle group ki pehchan karo, phir bahar wale ko chuno. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Phool-phool-phool-phal — phal alag. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: 'Sabhi kutte janwar hain; sabhi janwar jeevit hain' se kya nishkarsh nikalta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Venn se samjho: saare kutte janwar ke circle ke andar hain, aur saara janwar circle 'jeevit' ke andar hai — isliye saare kutte jeevit hain. | Galat kyun: A (koi kutta jeevit nahi) aur D (kuchh kutte jeevit nahi) ulta nishkarsh hain; C (kuchh janwar kutte nahi) kathn se nahi nikalta. | Concept: 'Sabhi A, B hain' + 'Sabhi B, C hain' → 'Sabhi A, C hain' (chain rule). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Circle ke andar circle — jo andar hai woh sab par lagu. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B6.

question: A ka vipreet (opposite) akshar kaun sa hai? (A=1...Z=26, yog 27)
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vipreet akshar ka yog 27 hota hai: A(1) + Z(26) = 27, isliye A ka opposite Z hai. | Galat kyun: A (Y) B ka opposite hai (2+25=27); B (B) A ke paas hai; C (X) C ka opposite hai (3+24=27). | Concept: Opposite letters — A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X… yog hamesha 27. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 27 ka joda — A+Z=27. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B1.

question: Uttar ki ore 5 km, phir dayein 3 km, phir dayein 4 km chalne par shuruaat se kitni doori hogi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Rasta banao: Uttar 5 km → dayein (Purab) 3 km → dayein (Dakshin) 4 km. Uttar-dakshin me bacha: 5 − 4 = 1 km uttar; purab 3 km. Seedhi doori = √(1² + 3²) = √10 km (Uttar-Purab disha). | Galat kyun: A (5 km) sirf pehla kadam hai; B (3 km) sirf purab ki doori hai; C (√5 km) 1²+2² se banta hai — purab 2 nahi, 3 hai. | Concept: Disha me kul chali doori nahi, shuruaat se seedhi doori (Pythagoras) nikalte hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Rasta banao, phir Pythagoras — √10. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B4.

question: Delhi : Bharat :: Paris : ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Delhi Bharat ki rajdhani hai, waise hi Paris France ki rajdhani hai — desh : rajdhani. | Galat kyun: B (Italy) aur C (Germany) desh hain, rajdhani nahi; D (London) Britain ki rajdhani hai, France ki nahi. | Concept: Analogy me sambandh pehchano — yahan 'desh : rajdhani'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Delhi→Bharat, Paris→France. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B5.

question: Yadi 1 Jan 2026 Thursday hai, to 8 Jan 2026 kaun sa din hoga?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 8 Jan, 1 Jan se 7 din baad hai; 7 din = poora ek hafta, isliye din wahi rahega — Thursday. | Galat kyun: A (Wednesday) ek din pehle hai; B (Friday) ek din baad hai; D (Saturday) do din baad hai. | Concept: 7 din baad wahi din aata hai — '7 ka niyam'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: +7 din = wahi din. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: Ghadi ki suiyan 12 ghante me kitni baar milti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Ghadi ki suiyan 12 ghante me 11 baar milti hain (lagbhag har 1 ghanta 5.5 minute me ek baar). | Galat kyun: B (12 baar) aam galti hai — 12 baje wali mulaqat do baar nahi gini jati; C (10) aur D (24) galat hain. | Concept: Suiyan har ~65.5 minute me milti hain, isliye 12 ghante me 11 baar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 12 ghante = 11 mulaqat — '12 nahi, 11'. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: 'Each of the students ___ present' — sahi verb chuniye.
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 'Each' singular hai, isliye singular verb 'is' aayega: 'Each of the students is present.' | Galat kyun: A (were), B (have), C (are) sab plural verbs hain — 'each' ke saath nahi aate. | Concept: 'Each/every' hamesha singular verb leta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Each = ek-ek — singular verb. | Source: Standard English grammar — 'Each' takes a singular verb (NCERT Class 10 English Grammar).

question: Statement: 'Sabhi A, B hain.' Isse kya nahi nikalta?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 'Sabhi A, B hain' se sirf 'Sabhi B, A hain' nahi nikalta — ulta nishkarsh galat hai. Venn se: A ka circle B ke andar hai, par B ka circle A ke andar nahi. | Galat kyun: B (Kuchh B, A hain) nikalta hai — A ke sabhi sadasya B me hain, isliye kuchh B to A hain hi; D (Kuchh A, B hain) bhi nikalta hai; C (Koi A, B nahi) kathn ke bilkul ulta hai. | Concept: 'Sabhi' ka ulta nahi hota — sirf 'Kuchh' ka nishkarsh nikalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sabhi A→B ≠ Sabhi B→A — ulta mat karo. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B6.

question: Vritt me kendra ki ore munh karke baithe vyakti ka 'dayein' kis disha me hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Vritt me kendra ki ore munh karke baithe vyakti ka 'dayein' ghadi ki vipreet (anticlockwise) disha hoti hai. Socho: kendra ki taraf dekhte hue tumhara dayein haath ghadi ki vipreet disha me jata hai. | Galat kyun: A (Uttar) aur B (Dakshin) sthir dishayein hain — 'dayein' vyakti ki baithne ki disha par nirbhar karta hai; C (ghadi ki disha) tab hota jab munh bahar ki ore ho. | Concept: Vritt me 'dayein/bayein' kendra ki ore munh karne par ulta ho jata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kendra ki ore munh = dayein ulta (anticlockwise). | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B7.

question: Pehle 10 prakritik sankhyaon ka yog kitna hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Pehle 10 prakritik sankhyaon ka yog = n(n+1)/2 = 10 × 11/2 = 55. | Galat kyun: A (50) 10 × 5 se banta hai — galat sutra; B (45) pehle 9 ka yog hai (9×10/2); D (60) 10 × 6 se banta hai. | Concept: Pehli n sankhyaon ka yog = n(n+1)/2. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: n(n+1)/2 — 10×11÷2 = 55. | Source: Standard arithmetic series formula (NCERT Class 10 Mathematics Ch. 5, Arithmetic Progressions).

question: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ... agla prime kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Prime shrinkhala: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 ke baad 13 aata hai. | Galat kyun: A (12) aur D (15) composite hain — prime nahi; B (17) 13 ke baad ka prime hai. | Concept: Prime = sirf 1 aur khud se vibhajya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Prime kram — 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17… | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §A1.

question: Kathn: 'Rajasthan ke sabhi jilon me khel maidan banaye jayenge.' — Is kathn me kaun si purvadharana (assumption) antarnit hai?
option_a: Khel maidan banane se khel pratibha badhegi
option_b: Rajasthan me abhi koi khel maidan nahi hai
option_c: Sabhi jile khel maidan chahte hain
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Khel maidan banane ka faisla isliye liya jata hai kyunki mana jata hai ki isse khel pratibha badhegi — yahi antarnit purvadharana hai. | Galat kyun: B (koi khel maidan nahi hai) galat hai — maidan pehle se hain; C (sabhi jile chahte hain) aur D (sasta hai) kathn se nahi nikalte. | Concept: Assumption = woh baat jo kathn ko sahi manne ke liye zaroori ho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Assumption poochho to 'kyun banaya ja raha hai' socho. | Source: notes/08_reasoning_mathematics.md §B8.
